l.i: S Emper ego infelix lugeda in funera fratrum,
Et quos morte sequi morientes non datur {na},
Sic me quantumuis annis, Lauatere, priorem-
Sic me, idem tecum in luce que protulit annus,
Qui sancte in terris mecum {vi}xistis, amici,
Hac eadem donec qua nos nunc separat, {na}

page.notes: Large decorative initial "S" in "Semper". Some characters in the verse are doubtful (abbreviation marks such as "{na}", "{vi}" are approximations). Final word "RODOL-" is a catchword at the foot.
